old_findings.note: The inner hash is now sha3(val, age, 'ethusd') (196) and LogMedianPrice shows val and age; but the outer hash given to ecrecover got worse (regression 1).
Signer re-read as memory slices and '16 * Mask(251, 1, val_.length)' unchanged.

regressions.source: median.sol recover: ecrecover(keccak256(abi.encodePacked('\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32', keccak256(abi.encodePacked(val_, age_, wat)))), v, r, s)
regressions.issue: The message given to ecrecover was the decoded prefix hash; it is now a raw memory range whose length keeps '_8 - _9' (0: both are mem[64] read with only stores at mem[64] + 32..96 in between), although the same function now folds '_8 - mem[64]' to 0 two lines earlier.
regressions.rule: Two reads of mem[64] separated only by stores at mem[64] + k (k >= 32, above the constant floor 128) are equal; fold _8 - _9 to 0, then mem[_8 + 160 len 60] decodes as Bytes(28, prefix), sha3(val, age, 'ethusd').

improvements: The nine LibNote anonymous logs show their data as Array(len=224, data=call.data[0 len 224]) instead of '32, 224, ...'; poke's inner message hash reads sha3(val, age, 'ethusd') and LogMedianPrice is printed with its two arguments.
notes: Diff of 126 lines read in full.
summary: Events decoded better (LibNote logs, LogMedianPrice) and poke's inner hash resolved, but the ecrecover message regressed from the decoded prefix hash to a raw memory sha3 with an unsimplified '_8 - _9'.
